description: Navigate the package hierarchy. Without parameters, returns top-level `packages`. With a `packageId`, returns that package's children up to the specified depth. Each node carries `id`, `name`, `parentId`, and `elementCount`.

depth.description: How many levels deep to recurse (max 3, default 1)

packageId.description: Package ID to get children of. Omit for top-level packages.

name: ea_get_package_tree
